text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync - we need to tighten the operator UX for automatic rollouts + fallback. current flow spams banners when a degrade flips.
Jasper Ortiz: Totally. ops get multiple interrupts. :grimacing: can we reduce noise?
Ava Patel: Proposal: single compact 'safeguard' chip in the top-right with hover and expandable timeline. keeps info but avoids modal spam.
Lee Novak: Chip good, but must surface a 1-click operator action (ack/override). prioritize 'view audit' as primary, override as secondary.
Maya Chen: Primary = "View audit & metrics". Secondary = "Operator override". include prefilled ack fields.
Riley Gomez: Triggers we care about: 5xx spike, p95 latency, eval-quality fail. should the chip show which fired?
Jasper Ortiz: Show a short badge: `5xx` or `latency`. tooltip with metric. compact state must be terse.
Ava Patel: Add red/yellow/green dot for severity; legend in timeline.
deploy-bot: [notice] Canary rollout started 2023-11-14T09:12:11Z. safeguard triggered: p95_latency>1200ms.
Lee Novak: Audit flow needs a stamped timeline entry and a prefilled incident note on ack. capture trigger, model, route, sampling_id.
Maya Chen: Ack minimal fields: who, reason (preset list + free text), auto-restore enabled?
Riley Gomez: If auto-restore on, show passive 'watching - will auto-restore on sustained healthy metrics' not a countdown.
Jasper Ortiz: Agreed. countdown causes anxiety. show last sample time and recovery criteria.
Ava Patel: Backend will emit `safeguard.triggered` events. UI should render generic payload fields. sample: ```{
"trigger":"p95_latency",
"value":1350,
"threshold":1200,
"route":"/v1/generate",
"model":"redwood-rlf-3b",
"sampling_id":"smp_0a1b2c"
}```
Lee Novak: Add a 'copy payload' button for runbooks.
Maya Chen: Retention: legal wants 1 year default for enterprise. workspace-level override.
Riley Gomez: Telemetry: one-click drilldown to last N matched requests, anonymized. ops wants replay link into sandbox.
Jasper Ortiz: Dry-run simulate rollback in timeline: show expected traffic split and latency/cost delta.
Ava Patel: Dry-run preview is critical. show cost/latency delta and expected success window.
deploy-bot: [action] Created ENG-rlf-842 "safeguard compact chip + timeline"
Lee Novak: Next: Maya mock chip + expand timeline, Jasper spec payload + schema, Ava wire dry-run datapoints, Riley define telemetry acceptance.
Maya Chen: I'll post Figma by EOD and link here. tagging @Riley Gomez for telemetry acceptance criteria.
Riley Gomez: Checklist: event shape, sample export, replay link, anonymization rules.
Ava Patel: Edge case: if multiple triggers within 30s, collapse into 'multi-trigger' group with list on expand to avoid alert storms.
Jasper Ortiz: Chip summary = severity dot, primary trigger short name, model, quick actions (view/audit/override).
Maya Chen: Thanks all. will post mock and prototype link shortly.
Lee Novak: :thumbsup:
Riley Gomez: :rocket:
